imageAlt: painted brick home with restrained warm white lights tracing its gabled rooflines at dusk
name: Roofline Christmas Lighting
title: Roofline Christmas Light Installation | Glow Artisans
description: Custom roofline Christmas lighting for Northern Virginia and nearby Maryland homeowners. Supplied lights, installation, seasonal care, removal and storage included.
headline: Roofline Christmas lighting.
intro: Give your home a clear, welcoming outline for the holidays. We plan Christmas lights around your roofline, gables and exterior architectural details, with every part of the season handled by one team.
summary: A tailored outline for your roofline, gables and architectural details.
focus: A balanced view from the street
sectionTitle: Follow the lines that make your home yours.
sectionIntro: A roofline display works best when the lighting feels intentional. We help you decide which edges to highlight, where the design should stop, and how it relates to the rest of your exterior.
features: Roof edges & gables
Define the silhouette of your home with a considered lighting layout. The design accounts for the roof sections visible from your preferred viewing points.
Architectural balance
Discuss how peaks, porch roofs and exterior details should work together, rather than outlining every available surface.
A coordinated welcome
Keep the roofline as the main feature, or connect it with tree lighting, wreaths and garlands for a complete exterior display.
planningTitle: The roofline is only part of the plan.
planningText: Roof height, roof shape, access and power locations all influence the installation plan. We review those details before confirming the areas included in your project and the installation schedule.
checklist: Which sides of the home you want visible after dark
Roof peaks, porch roofs or other details you want emphasized
Exterior power access and any access restrictions
Your preferred look and installation timing
faqs: Can I request roofline lighting without a full-home display?
Yes, you can inquire about a roofline-focused project. Standalone service depends on the size and scope of the project; we confirm suitability after reviewing your home.
Do you light every roof edge?
Not necessarily. We design around the appearance you want and the roof sections that can be included in the installation plan. The agreed layout identifies which areas will be lit.
How do you plan for high roofs or difficult access?

Share the areas you want decorated and any known access limitations. We review roof height, shape and installation access before confirming the design; not every surface or location can be assumed suitable.

imageAlt: mature tree and shrubs wrapped in small warm white lights beside a brick home
name: Tree & Shrub Christmas Lighting
title: Tree & Shrub Christmas Light Installation | Glow Artisans
description: Bring your outdoor trees and shrubs into a custom Christmas lighting design. All-inclusive installation, seasonal maintenance, removal and storage by Glow Artisans.
headline: Tree & shrub Christmas lighting.
accent: Bring the garden into the celebration.
intro: Create a holiday welcome beyond the roofline. We design outdoor tree and shrub lighting around the way you approach and enjoy your home, then supply, install and care for the agreed display.
summary: Outdoor focal points that connect your home, garden and approach.
sectionTitle: Choose the focal points. Let the garden glow.
sectionIntro: The right grouping can be more effective than lighting every plant. We look at scale, spacing and viewing angles to create a display that feels balanced with your home.
features: Feature trees
Make a selected outdoor tree a focal point. We discuss the look of trunk and branch lighting and confirm what is practical for its size and access.
Shrubs & planted areas
Use lighting in selected shrubs to bring the holiday design closer to the ground and create continuity across the front of the property.
The approach home

Coordinate garden lighting with your roofline or entrance. The plan considers the view along the drive and from the front door, without treating decorative lights as a substitute for functional path lighting.
planningTitle: A design shaped by your landscape.
planningText: Tree size, branch structure, planting density and available power affect the display. We review the proposed trees and shrubs, installation access and the areas you want to keep clear before agreeing the scope.
checklist: The trees and shrubs you would like considered
The view from the street, driveway and home
Outdoor power locations and access to planting beds
Areas that need to remain clear for everyday use
faqs: Can you decorate just one tree or a group of shrubs?
You are welcome to request a focused display. Whether we can take it on as a standalone project depends on its size and scope, which we review before confirming service.
Can every tree be wrapped in Christmas lights?
The design depends on the tree’s size, branch structure and access. We review the trees you have in mind and confirm which lighting treatments and areas can be included.
Can tree lighting match the lights on my house?
Yes. We can plan the house and garden together so the lighting feels coordinated. Tell us which exterior areas you want included when requesting your estimate.

imageAlt: Georgian brick entrance with an evergreen wreath, burgundy ribbon and softly lit garland
name: Outdoor Wreaths & Garlands
title: Outdoor Christmas Wreath & Garland Installation | Glow Artisans
description: Custom outdoor holiday decorating with wreaths and garlands for entrances, porches and exterior details. Design, supplied décor, installation, care, removal and storage.
headline: Outdoor wreaths & garlands.
accent: A warmer welcome starts at the door.
intro: Frame your entrance with a holiday design that belongs to your home. We plan outdoor wreaths and garlands around your porch and exterior details, with supplied décor and complete seasonal service.
summary: A thoughtfully dressed entrance, porch and exterior architectural details.
sectionTitle: The finishing touches can set the whole mood.
sectionIntro: Scale and placement make the difference between a collection of decorations and a cohesive welcome. We tailor the outdoor décor to your entrance and the rest of your holiday display.
features: Outdoor wreaths
Discuss wreath placement and proportion for your entrance or other suitable exterior features. Specific decorations are selected as part of the agreed design.
Garlands & framing
Explore garlands for suitable porch details, columns or railings. We consider everyday access and the surface involved before confirming placement.
One consistent style
Coordinate greenery, decorative accents and any agreed lighting with the roofline and garden, or keep the entrance as the focus of the project.
planningText: Your entrance needs to work throughout the season. We consider door movement, railings, walking space, exterior surfaces and access before finalizing the décor layout and installation approach.
checklist: The doors, porch features or railings you want decorated
Your preferred colors and overall holiday style
Door clearance and regularly used walkways
Other exterior lighting or decorations to coordinate with
faqs: Can I book wreaths and garlands without Christmas lighting?
You can request an outdoor décor-focused project. Standalone availability depends on the project’s size and scope; we will review your ideas before confirming what we can provide.
Do you decorate indoor staircases, mantels or trees?
No. This service is exclusively for outdoor holiday decorating. We focus on exterior entrances, porches and other agreed outdoor features.
Can I choose a style for the wreaths and garlands?
Yes. Share your preferred look or inspiration during planning. We confirm the specific decorations, accents and any lighting as part of your custom design.

imageAlt: traditional brick home with coordinated roofline lighting, a lit garden tree and entrance greenery
name: Complete-Home Exterior Holiday Decorating
title: Complete-Home Christmas Lighting & Outdoor Decorating | Glow Artisans
description: One custom exterior holiday design for your roofline, garden and entrance. All-inclusive Christmas lighting and outdoor decorating for homeowners by Glow Artisans.
headline: Complete-home holiday decorating.
intro: Bring your roofline, outdoor trees and entrance together in one custom holiday design. Glow Artisans handles the supplied lights and decorations, installation, seasonal care, removal and storage for your agreed exterior display.
summary: A coordinated exterior plan that brings architecture, garden and entrance together.
sectionTitle: Designed together, from the first impression.
sectionIntro: A complete-home plan is not a fixed bundle or a promise to decorate every surface. It is a coordinated design across the outdoor areas you choose, with a clearly agreed scope.
features: The house
Set the foundation with roofline and architectural lighting. We choose the details that give the display its structure and establish the overall look.
The landscape
Carry the design into selected trees and shrubs. The garden can frame the house, create a focal point or make the approach feel more welcoming.
The entrance
Finish with outdoor wreaths, garlands and agreed decorative accents. These details connect the larger display to the moment guests arrive at your door.
planningTitle: Start with how you want the whole home to feel.
planningText: Tell us your priorities and preferred look. We review the exterior areas together, discuss access and power, and define a coordinated scope before confirming installation. Interior decorating is not included.
checklist: The overall style you want for the exterior
Your must-have areas and optional additions
The views from the street, drive and front door
Your preferred installation timing and access needs
faqs: Does complete-home decorating include the interior?
No. Complete-home refers to a coordinated exterior holiday design. Indoor trees, rooms, mantels and staircases are not part of this service.
Does the package include every outdoor area?
There is no fixed one-size-fits-all bundle. We agree the roofline sections, trees, shrubs and outdoor décor included in your design before installation.
Can I prioritize some areas and leave others undecorated?
Absolutely. A custom design starts with your priorities. We can focus the composition on the areas that matter most while keeping the overall exterior look cohesive.
